decision: Broader coverage falsifies apparent R9 edge. No arm profitable in all three periods. No production changes.

protocol.market: At UTC 0/6/12/18 market state uses BTC fully closed trailing24/72h and >=8 assets with 25 finite H1 closes; breadth >=60% down for BEAR or <=40% down for BULL. Market breadth independent of M5 tradability.
protocol.asset: Only original R3 individual QA-passing symbols eligible for entries. 72h or 168h beta and residual std calculated on continuous past H1. At least 2 eligible to rank. No future label filtering.

arms.BEAR_REV168: BEAR SHORT highest standardized residual24h >=0.5 using beta168
arms.BEAR_MOM168: BEAR SHORT lowest standardized residual24h <=-0.5 using beta168
arms.BEAR_REV72: BEAR SHORT highest standardized residual24h >=0.5 using beta72
arms.BEAR_MOM72: BEAR SHORT lowest standardized residual24h <=-0.5 using beta72
arms.BEAR_REV_FADE72: BEAR SHORT residual24h>=0.5, latest residual6h<0, rank residual24h
arms.BEAR_BTC_REV72: BTC24/72 down regardless of breadth, SHORT highest residual24h>=0.5
arms.MIXED_REV72: MIXED choose largest absolute residual24h>=1.5 opposite side

protocol.exit: 12/24/48h fixed, STOP8 gap adverse, 10/30bps, Gross .30 per position, original 2 slot 12h cooldown. All source periods inspected; no funding; no production.
protocol.controls: 32 same-time randomized other QA-eligible symbols for each arm with at least 2 profitable splits, plus both REV/MOM 72 24h and 48h. Exact same side/horizon/portfolio. Diagnostic matched cohorts. No independence claims.
